programme.title: Card Sharks
programme.desc: This show from legendary Mark Goodson-Bill Todman Productions features two contestants trying to predict answers to survey questions for the opportunity to play a game with oversized playing cards for a chance to win cash. One contestant guesses how many people (out of 100) gave a certain answer to a question and the other contestant then guesses if the number is higher or lower than the opponent's guess. The winning contestant then faces a row of cards and must determine if each succeeding card is higher or lower than the one that precedes it. The contestant who wins two out of three games wins the match and plays the bonus round, called Money Cards. The Money Cards round is similar to the card game in the main game but with three levels of cards instead of one row. The contestant is given $200 at the beginning of Money Cards and wagers any or all of that money when guessing if the cards will be higher or lower than the previous one. A perfect round could earn the contestant $28,800.

programme.title: Super Password
programme.desc: Like the 1960s version, two contestants, each teamed with a celebrity partner, compete in a word-association game. One player tries to guess a word based on clues offered by his or her partner. The game is timed, and if the clue-giver inadvertently says part of the word, a buzzer sounds and that round is lost. The team with the most points at the end of the round gets to go on to a fast-paced bonus round called Cashword.

One contestant guesses how many people (out of 100) gave a certain answer to a question and the other contestant then guesses if the number is higher or lower than the opponent's guess. The winning contestant then faces a row of cards and must determine if each succeeding card is higher or lower than the one that precedes it. The contestant who wins two out of three games wins the match and plays the bonus round, called Money Cards. The Money Cards round is similar to the card game in the main game but with three levels of cards instead of one row. The contestant is given $200 at the beginning of Money Cards and wagers any or all of that money when guessing if the cards will be higher or lower than the previous one. A perfect round could earn the contestant $28,800.

programme.title: 48 Hours
programme.desc: This newsmagazine investigates intriguing crime and justice cases that touch on all aspects of the human experience. Over its long run, the show has helped exonerate wrongly convicted people, driven the reopening -- and resolution -- of cold cases, and changed numerous lives. CBS News correspondents offer an in-depth look into each story, with the emphasis on solving the mystery at its heart. The program and its team have earned critical acclaim, including 20 Emmys and three Peabody Awards.

programme.sub-title: Deal With The Devil - Maggie Ybarra
programme.desc: Nobody knew about suburban dad Michael Hendricks' dark sexual fantasies or his dangerous dalliance with Maggie Ybarra. In her first-ever interview, Ybarra reveals to host David Scott what it was like to fall under the spell of the Devil Next Door - and how their twisted partnership ended with abusive mind games, a shocking murder, and an innocent life destroyed.

programme.title: Interview With a Killer
programme.desc: When flames tore through a Buffalo, New York home in 2018, the investigation revealed a toxic relationship and a hot-tempered arsonist, Frank Bredt, Jr. Now Bredt is talking about his crime from behind bars. In this episode of Interview With a Killer, host David Scott revisits the fire, the evidence, and the unraveling timeline - exposing a jilted lover hidden behind smoke and destruction and giving viewers an unfiltered look into the chilling death of an innocent mother.

programme.title: Interview With a Killer
programme.desc: In 2013, the small city of Weatherford, Texas was rocked by the brutal slaying of local son, JD Doss. The murder weapon? A pickaxe. The murderer? His close friend, 24-year-old Nicholas Camfield. In a shocking twist, Camfield not only killed his victim by repeatedly striking him in the head, he also mutilated, scalped, and defiled his body over the course of days. In one of David Scott's most shocking interviews, Camfield gives a glimpse inside his deranged, murderous mind.

programme.title: Interview With a Killer
programme.sub-title: The Golden Boy - Tommy Gilbert, Jr
programme.desc: In his first ever television interview, killer Thomas Gilbert, Jr. discusses the murder that shook New York's elite. The Princeton-educated Gilbert became a tabloid obsession when he shot his father after his $1,000 allowance was cut off. But in this unique installment of Interview With a Killer, Gilbert appears to be a far cry from his once golden upbringing. Host David Scott explores his long history of mental illness and the privileged pressure cooker that shaped his downfall.

programme.title: Interview With a Killer
programme.desc: She's one of the most camera-friendly killers in true crime history. A glamorous Texas social climber turned convicted black widow. And this interview is unlike any that she's ever done. In this special episode of Interview With a Killer, host David Scott reveals the real Celeste - cunning, calculating, and deadly.

programme.title: Sins of the City

programme.title: Fatal Attraction
programme.desc: When a woman is found dead in a car, detectives quickly begin an investigation. What begins as a clear-cut case soon takes a turn when new leads complicate the story. Did her past come back to bite her? Or is someone’s unbridled rage to blame?

programme.title: Fatal Attraction
programme.desc: When a mother of six and her cousin are murdered less than two hours apart, police wonder if it�s a coincidence, or if the cases are connected. Soon, the killer�s friend comes forward with a twisted tale of revenge they never saw coming.

programme.title: For My Man
programme.sub-title: For My Man - Vanessa Coleman and Tamika Jasper-Barbary
programme.desc: Vanessa Coleman is dangerously in love. She’ll stand by her man as he tortures a frightened couple in a drug-induced rage all while she watches. Then Tamika Jasper-Barbary marries a handsome, hard worker, but when his job gets them in hot water, Tamika risks it all to save her love.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A woman unable to feel emotions gets a new lease on life when a brain implant allows her to experience feelings for the first time. But, when the implant malfunctions, driving her towards insanity, she is shocked at the real cause of her problems.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A remorseless, uncaring scientist (Stephen Lang) and his partner (Michael Ontkean) discover a way to bring life back to the recently deceased. But after the scientist is killed and brought back to life himself, will he choose to live differently?

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Brilliant geneticist Martin Nodel (Ron Rifkin) unlocks a secret code imprinted on human DNA. But when he tests this code on himself, his "instincts" draw him to a remote location where he finds a trip…to The Outer Limits. Ryan Reynolds co-stars.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: When it is not known if aliens headed to Earth are friend or foe, five people are placed in secret bunkers to man switches that, if not pressed at specified intervals, will set off mass destruction that will destroy everything, alien or human alike.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Engaged as soldiers on a distant planet to prevent a race of alien bugs from stealing minerals that provide the Earth's energy, a woman (Christine Elise) and her troops accidentally discover that the real enemy may not be the aliens at all.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: When a seemingly harmless audio signal from space causes physiological changes in Earth's youth, a young scientist races against time to discover what exactly is happening and why. Could the changes be necessary for the survival of the planet?

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A despondent man finds himself torn between killing himself and killing his co-workers. Before he can do either, he's pulled into The Outer Limits where there are hundreds of versions of him, each with a different life and a different character.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A woman's life changes dramatically when she accidentally shoots herself in the head which causes her to not only grow more intelligent, but also to realize how dull her life was before the photo in a picture frame started talking to her.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: When an incident at a space station leaves three people dead, the captain of the ship returns to Earth to face murder charges. Is the captain a murderous madman? Or has he actually seen the face of evil floating in the zero-gravity of deep space?

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: The residents of a suburban neighborhood have their lives turned upside down when a four block section of their subdivision is ripped from the earth by a mysterious force and transported to a distant planet. David McCallum and Laura Harris star.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Muckraking TV journalist Donald Rivers (Alan Thicke), host of "The Whole Truth," has the show of a lifetime: rock solid-proof that the government and private defense contractors have been engaging in secret genetic cloning.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Using an experimental treatment, a scientist (Pat Morita) helps an aging athlete (Adrian Pasdar) end his career on a high note by accelerating his reflexes for one last match. But with victory comes side-effects...courtesy of The Outer Limits.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: In a society controlled by aliens, a mother rebels when she is forced to give up her child to Mother, a wise alien who acts as a parent to all infants. Determined to get the child back, she embarks upon a dangerous quest that will change her world.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: When Genetic Engineering creates super-babies, some suffer from Genetic Rejection Syndrome (GRS), making them stronger and more deadly. A detective (Gary Cole) must stop his GRS son, a suspected killer, but must take a serum to become more like him.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Hunters pay to hunt androids that have a chip that keeps them from harming humans. However, secretly planted data allows the androids to disable the chip, and the balance of power shifts between men and machines! Starring Ron White and Doug Savant.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Xenobiologist Teresa Janovitch (Melissa Gilbert) is on a military team searching an uninhabited planet for minerals. When the team is attacked by aliens and a retaliation is successful, Janovitch makes a shocking discovery about the victims.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Reporter Judy Warren (Kate Vernon) tracks down Josh (Alex McArthur), a recluse who performs miracles. Alien or angel? All that Judy knows is that now the military is involved and she doesn’t trust them. If she can help Josh, will she find the truth?

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A medical specialist (Peter Flemming) examines a case involving an epidemic that killed a number of children in a small town. Through hypnosis, he probes the mind of a surviving child (Rachel Leigh Cook) and unravels a memory of "alien" proportions.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: As part of a top-secret program, the brain content of a military Captain (Lou Diamond Phillips) is temporarily transferred to an android to create a superior soldier. But, when things go wrong, can the transfer be reversed? Also starring Robert Joy.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A group of hospital patients and their nurse, Marie Alexander (Maria Conchita Alonso), survive a global, terrorist bio-attack. A vaccine arrives, but there are only three doses. Who will be chosen? Will it be survival of the fittest?

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Bernard (Ayre Gross) is haunted by images from his past and the tragic death of his sister...a death he caused. An experimental treatment brings positive results, but also a dangerous side effect: Bernard can now transfer his fear to others!

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: When a transport ship Captain (C. Thomas Howell) is rescued after surviving a devastating crash on Venus, strange things begin to happen when he returns to Earth. He did what it took to survive on Venus, but could the price of survival be too high?

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A scientist (Gregory Harrison) in a colony on another planet urges evacuation when he discovers that a radioactive star will soon pass over. He has been wrong before, though, and at great cost. Will the truth be accepted in time to save the colony?

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Charlie Bouton (Tom Butler) and Melburn Ross (Michael Shanks) create Mary 25, a nanny robot. When Bouton falls in love with Mary and mistreats his wife, a woman whom Ross once loved, the lines between human and machine become dangerously blurred.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A negotiator (Brett Cullen) tries to find out why a grad student (Peter Stebbings) is threatening to detonate a deadly, self-made bomb, unless the government kills five people for him. Why those five people? Is it revenge? And can he be stopped?

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Four telekinetic people are recruited by the CIA, who hopes to use their talents to assassinate a war criminal. Their powers produce unexpected side-effects; however, and the killers may soon find that they are the prey. Robert Guillaume stars.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: When Dr. Nodel (Ron Rifkin) is joined on an alien ship by a small group of students to communicate with aliens, it appears that they’ve all been led into a trap. Have the aliens led them astray? Ryan Reynolds also stars. Sequel to “Double Helix”.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A battle cruiser is captured by the enemy Ebonites on planet N-1-8-4. Imprisoned, the crew is interrogated by The Voice, an unseen Ebonite. Who will be the first to snap? And what will happen then? Starring Maurice Dean Wint and Steven Bauer.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: In the world of 2055, men are extinct. Preserved by cryonics, a man (David Keith) awakens in Lithia, a poor matriarchy. He’s welcomed, but when he upsets the natural order of things, the question arises: Can the world men be revived? And should it?

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: When two archeologists (Lisa Zane, David Cubitt) discover a cocooned alien that suddenly begins to reanimate, the rest of the research team turns greedy, wanting to cash in on it. When the couple refuses, they find themselves numbered...or are they?

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: An alien (Rene Auberjonois) and his family live on a secure farm on Earth, where they grow their own food. Most of the aliens believe that the human race was wiped out in the war, but there is a group of humans in the woods...and they are starving!

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A doctor (Maurice Godin) creates a controversial process to reverse aging and disease. So, when an older woman (Barbara Rush) he loves is close to death, he knows he can save her. But there is always a price to be paid...in The Outer Limits.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: On Mars, the Free Alliance and the Coalition of Middle-Eastern and Pacific States mine minerals under a truce until an apparent attack on Earth. Without clear evidence of war, is retaliation wise, or hasty? Barbara Eve Harris and Adam Baldwin star.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A former soldier (Ron Perlman) has horrifying flashbacks from his days as a member of a covert branch of the military. But when flashback star to become reality, he wonders whether he is insane...or if there a new covert mission afoot.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Mac 27 (Nicolas Lea) is Innobotics' newest android. He’s emotionless, but he escapes after a glitch and takes a hostage, Celia (Nana Visitor). She sees human qualities in Mac and tries to convince him that he has feelings. But why help her captor?

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Joe Pantoliano stars as a shock-jock whose specialty is ridiculing UFO believers. But when a true Believer sets himself on fire in front of Stan, the D.J. finds the very foundation of his disbelief beginning to crumble. Cynthia Nixon also stars.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: When a cancer-ridden doctor (Robert Hayes) is given a full-body transplant, he soon develops disturbing visions of a life he never led, of loves he's never experienced... and of a shocking, brutal murder. Wendel Meldrum and Thomas Cavanaugh also star.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A brilliant inventor (Ralph Waite) who murdered a man who stole credit for his work, is double crossed by the other inmates in jail when they discover his "small friends" -- microscopic machines --can seve just about any purposeï¿½including jailbreak.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: The Grell had come to earth not as equals, but as slaves. Now, an uprising has gripped the world in fear, and a high-ranking government official (Ted Shackelford), who is lost in Grell territory, experiences firsthand the ugly face of racism.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Dr. Eberhardt (Ralph Macchio) discovers a way for comatose patients to communicate with each other by interfacing with a computer. But when he hooks himself up to the machine, he discovers a cyberspace "paradise" he may never be able to leave!

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Cliff Robertson -- who starred in the very first episode of the classic series -- returns to the Outer Limits as an aging astronaut whose 1963 mission was a career-ending disaster. If he can just get back to space, perhaps he can clear his name.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Like other Star Fleet vessels, Ship (voice of Malcolm McDowell) has evolved and now controls the only human (Jack Noseworthy) aboard. But the relationship takes a dramatic turn when Man meets Woman and fights machine in a desperate bid for freedom!

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Do our memories define our identity? If we are merely the sum of our experiences, what do we become if those experiences are lost? Hope Wilson (Robbie Chong) faces this question when she meets a man who has purposely erased his own memories.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Courtesy of a freak accident (and The Outer Limits), an agoraphobe (Jane Adams) begins to hear the private thoughts of all of the tenants in her building...the good, the bad and the steamy. And it seems at least one of them may want to kill her.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A scientist -- who is also a religious zealot (David Ogden Stiers) -- secretly implants an embryo created with DNA from the Shroud of Turin into a young woman (Samantha Mathis) in order to scientifically engineer the Second Coming of Christ.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: The Outer Limits come to Victorian Whitechapel when a London doctor (Cary Elwes) races to capture the alien creature responsible for the Jack the Ripper murders. But when the alien frames the good doctor for the murders, his time may be up.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: The son (Saul Rubinek) of a concentration camp survivor (Peter Boretski) gets some unique help in proving the guilt of a former Nazi (Jan Rubes) living in the U.S....courtesy of a time traveler (Alex Daikun) and, of course, The Outer Limits.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: The planets Earth and Dregocia struggle to re-establish a fragile trust after a summit goes tragically wrong. Can a diplomat (Marcia Cross) calm the hawkish nature of both species…and can she overcome her own prejudices to save both worlds?

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A meek anthropologist (Leland Orser) develops a serum for genetic dominance and tests it on himself. Now his newfound confidence takes complete control of him, turning him into an irrational, overly aggressive troglodyte! Can he reverse the process?

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: The Haven is a high-tech apartment building which is run by supercomputer and almost completely eliminates the need for human contact. But when things begin to go wrong, neighbors who have never met must learn to work together in order to survive!

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: When a scientist's (Kevin Nealon) experiment unintentionally creates a rift in the space-time continuum, he suddenly find himself caught in a time loop and soon begins to suspects sabotage. Terri Hawkes, Jennifer Copping and Ronny Cox also star.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A boy (Adam Hann-Byrd) , picked on by high-school bullies and neglected by his own father (Daniel Hugh Kelley), finds comfort in an alien (Chris Potter) who has crash-landed on earth. But is the alien what he claims to be? Never…in The Outer Limits.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: In a world dominated by alien invaders, a cynical American cafe owner (Nathan Fillion) must decide if he will risk his life to help an old lover fight for Earth or if he is happy not rocking the political boat. Derek de Lint also stars.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: When Detective Terry Russo (Megan Gallagher) is called to investigate a double murder, she discovers she may be solving not one crime, but possibly hundreds. And that the culprit -- or culprits -- may not be human at all. Michael Riley also stars.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A convicted murderer is turned loose only to be hunted by the sister of his victim as part the hottest show on television, Judgment Day, which allows the family members -- and the at home audience -- to act as judge, jury and executioner!

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: An ex-con who had been serving time for spousal abuse is bent on revenge against his wife. He purchases a strange handgun from a gun dealer and finds this is no ordinary weapon and, in fact, he becomes quite attached to it…literally.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A device that allows people to change their appearance helps a nerdy guy become the mirror image of his hunky co-worker.. Now arrogant with his new-found good looks, the former nerd experiences a life like never before…and now he wants to keep it.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: An invisible alien race that inhabits the energy systems of a deserted spaceship envelopes the crew of a salvage team, responding to the empty vessel's distress signal, in a web of paranoia, suspicion and murder. Michael Shanks stars.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: When a scientist uses his time machine to travel into the future, he discovers his wife lying dead in a pool of blood and a man fleeing the scene. Determined save her, he uses the time machine to go back in time...but is her death inevitable?

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A blind man (Mackenzie Astin) regains his sight only to be used by the government for his unique ability to see an alien from another dimension who has been trapped on Earth and yearns to return home. But the government has other plans for her.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A veterinarian (Jessica Tuck) in a small farming community becomes alarmed when a genetically-engineered corn seed, intended to produce faster, larger yields of corn, produces something far more alarming …human mutations! Len Cariou also stars.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: After losing his wife and son in a horrific car accident some twenty years earlier, a scientist (Joel Gray) uses advanced technology to build the perfect robotic version of his son. But perfection is not always so perfect...in The Outer Limits.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Due to dwindling resources in the future, the world consists of "Alphas" and "Betas" who are alternately put in stasis for 72 hour periods, all in service to the "Elites," who lord over the Alphas and the Betas...But a resistance is coming.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: When a man arrives at al UFO convention with part of an alien ship, it throws the annual gathering of "true believers" into chaos and leads to a conspiracy, a cover-upï¿½and murder. But who is conspiring with whom? And what are they covering up?

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: After being brought back from death, a woman (Laura Leighton) discovers she was one part of a pair of conjoined twins, the other lost during pregnancy. And now that twin, living dormant in her body for all these years, wants a life of her own.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Tom (Tate Donovan) and Wendy (Gabrielle Miller) are the perfect couple, happy and very much in love. But at night, Tom has terrible memory flashes about being stuck in a burning building The nightmares, however, aren't real…and neither is Tom.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: After the plane he is traveling in is struck by lightning, a Presidential candidate is visited by a time traveler who tells him that he needs to escape impending death because his presidency is the key to preventing an apocalyptic future.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: The crew of a space salvage ship is awakened from hyper-sleep when they come across a mysterious object floating through space. They soon discover the pod contains a tyrant, in stasis, who was banished from Earth for crimes against humanity.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A man travels back to his home town in order to investigate his brother's murder, allegedly at the hands of his brother's wife. He quickly discovers his hometown has drastically changed...and the residents seem to be under some form of mind control.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A preacher (Gary Busey), who lost his faith when his wife died, performs staged healing miracles at tent revivals until he finds his faith -- and livelihood -- being tested as never before by the appearance of a mysterious wheelchair-bound man.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Two friends re-enacting the Battle of Gettysburg unwittingly find themselves transported back in time and taken prisoner by a deranged Confederate colonel (Meatloaf) who might not only endanger their future…but the future of the country as well.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A teenage boy (Joseph Gordon-Levitt) suspects that the tenant (Judd Nelson) now taking up residence in his mother's backyard apartment is actually an alien on a deadly mission…a suspicion that puts the boy and his mother in grave danger.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: An anarchist (Frank Whaley), who was once rabidly pro-technology, threatens to blow up the central computers that control the world. As he negotiates with Pete Yastremski (John Amos) to surrender, we discover what led him down this dark path.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: When the leader of an Arctic exploration team kills two colleagues, psychologist Jack Burrell (William Cummins) is sent up to counsel the staff, including an old "friend" (Robert Sean Leonard), and to find the cause of an infectious psychosis.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Time-traveler Dr. Theresa Givens (Amanda Plummer) faces the death penalty for using her time machine in a future where all technology is banned due to a devastating nuclear holocaust some 20 years earlier. Charlton Heston also stars.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: An overworked father who wants to relieve the tension in his home due to the demands of his job orders a robot to keep house and perform other chores. Much to the father's surprise, the robot starts to replace him as head of the household.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A military colonel travels into the past from a plagued-ridden future where billions have died from a deadly virus. His mission: track down Patient Zero, the woman who had all three strains of DNA that produced the virus and assassinate her.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A couple and their friend join a mysterious religious sect in order to lead a more spiritual existence and find a new direction in life. They soon learn, however, that their new-found direction may take them further than they ever thought possible.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Young and artistic Claire Linkwood, who struggles financially to make ends meet, volunteers for a surrogate mother program. But after the embryo is successfully implanted at the clinic, she begins to have nightmares of a most "alien" nature.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: The lone survivor (Jere Burns) of a space shuttle disaster discovers he's greatly transformed since surviving the crash. For one, his body seems to be indestructible, and he embraces a new-found humanity…courtesy of The Outer Limits.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Mona Lisa, an android who was created to spy and kill, is designed with superior intelligence. But it is that superior intellect which allows her to evolve, leading her to question the morality of her prime directive...and her own existence.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A biogeneticist clones successfully his wife, who is near death in a coma with no expectation of survival. But when his real wife suddenly awakens from her coma, he finds life with not one, but two wives may be quite complicated.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A man (Enrico Colantoni) has second thoughts about a process that transmits a copy of a person light years away but requires that the human "shell" left behind be destroyed in order to maintain a balance in the Universe.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: An unemployed man wanders into a curio shop owned by a shape-shifting alien and is offered a rather unique wallet...one that fills with the money of anyone the man comes in physical contact with. However, if it's too good to be true, it often is.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW

programme.title: Danger Mouse

programme.title: Danger Mouse

programme.title: Count Duckula: Jungle Duck

programme.title: Count Duckula: Duck and the Broccoli Stalk

programme.title: Danger Mouse

programme.title: Count Duckula: Venice a Duck Not a Duck

programme.title: Danger Mouse

programme.title: Count Duckula: Transylvanian Take-Away
programme.desc: Gaston and Pierre and Von Goosewing break into Castle Duckula to steal two vases.

programme.title: Danger Mouse

programme.title: Count Duckula: Private Beak

programme.title: Danger Mouse
programme.desc: Danger Mouse and Penfold are golfing when they are called by Colonel K to meet with space alien J. J. Quark, who wants to make a treaty with them in North Africa.

programme.title: The Wombles

programme.title: Count Duckula: All in a Fog
programme.desc: Inspired to be a detective, Duckula travels to England to solve a mystery.

programme.title: Count Duckula: Ghostly Gold

programme.title: Danger Mouse
programme.desc: Danger Mouse and Penfold are in Hong Kong where they are trying to arrest Baron Greenback.

programme.title: Count Duckula: Return of the Curse of the Secret of the Mummy's Tomb Meets Franken Duckula's Monster.
programme.desc: Duckula is chased by an alien cabbage, a werewolf, a mummy, Frankenstein's monster, Von Goosewing, and some angry villagers.

programme.title: The Wombles
programme.desc: Orinoco is shamed into exercising by a new weighing machine.
programme.sub-title: Weighing in Time / Musical Wombles / Wombles and Ladders / Orinoco and the Ghost

programme.title: Danger Mouse
programme.desc: Dr Crumhorn holds Penfold captive and has created a robot duplicate of him (which is far more efficient than the original). At the push of a button, it transforms into a giant machine intent on destroying Danger Mouse and his pillar box.

programme.title: Danger Mouse
programme.desc: Penfold gets a pop-up book of monsters from a mysterious book sales club, but it turns out to be from J.J. Quark who turns the monsters in the book alive. Danger Mouse eventually turns the tide by drawing in a monster of his own.
programme.sub-title: Have You Fled from any Good Books Lately?

programme.title: Danger Mouse
programme.desc: Danger Mouse and Penfold had to the China seas to look for Professor Squakencluck who, despite having invented an object that can never be lost, ends up dropping the item in a remote island and getting lost himself.

programme.title: Danger Mouse
programme.desc: Dr Crumhorn returns and uses his transformation pills to turn himself into a little girl in an attempt to persuade Danger Mouse and Penfold to help her out and eventually lead them to break into Fort Knox.

programme.title: Count Duckula: Dr. Goosewing & Mr Duck
programme.desc: Goosewing creates a formula where when drunk, the victim becomes the complete opposite of their original selves.

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: Las esperanzas de llegar a Namek se pierden tras un desafortunado incidente con la cápsula de Nappa. Al menos hasta que el Sr. Popo revela a Bulma y sus amigos el paradero de la nave espacial con la que Dios llegó a la Tierra.
programme.sub-title: ¡El misterio de Yunzabit! La búsqueda de la nave espacial de Dio

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: Mientras se ultiman los preparativos, Bulma y sus amigos deben decidir quiénes viajarán hasta el lejano Namek. Finalmente los elegidos son Bulma, Klilyn y Gohan, que antes deberá convencer a su sobreprotectora madre.
programme.sub-title: ¡Despegue hacia Namekusei! El terror que espera a Gohan y a sus amigos.

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: En su viaje a través del espacio, Bulma, Klilyn y Gohan tratan de ayudar a una gigantesca colonia espacial de niños. Pero antes tendrán que convencerles de que no trabajan para Freeza, el malvado tirano que destruyó su planeta natal.
programme.sub-title: ¿Amigos o enemigos? El misterio de los niños de la nave espacial gigante.

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: as convencer a sus captores de que no tienen nada que ver con Freeza, Bulma y sus amigos continúan su viaje hacia Namek. Mientras, Vegeta encuentra refugio en una base militar de Freeza y comienza su recuperación.
programme.sub-title: ¿De verdad que es verdad? Ése es el planeta de la esperanza, Namek

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: Parece que nuestros astronautas han tenido suerte. Dos namekianos les han atendido amablemente, ¡hasta les quieren ayudar a encontrar las bolas de dragón! No hay tiempo que perder y comienza la búsqueda
programme.sub-title: Los alienígenas amables. La bola de cinco estrellas aparece de repente

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: La búsqueda de las Bolas de Dragón va viento en popa hasta que Bulma, Krilín y Son Gohan caen en una inesperada trampa
programme.sub-title: Planeta Freeza número 79. ¡La recuperación de Vegeta!

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: Los tres viajeros han sido víctimas de un engaño, ¡dos extraterrestres les han tomado el pelo! Gohan y Krilín tendrán que reunir todo su ingenio para engañar a los villanos y marcharse del inhóspito planeta.
programme.sub-title: ¡Aquí están todas las bolas de dragón! Piccolo volverá a la vida

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: Esta vez nuestros amigos llegan sanos y salvos al auténtico Namek, el planeta en que esperan encontrar las Bolas de Dragón para resucitar al Todopoderoso y tener de nuevo Bolas de Dragón en la Tierra
programme.sub-title: ¡Un nuevo enemigo terrorífico! El tirano espacial Freeza

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: Freezer ha detectado a Krilín y Gohan y envía a sus guerreros a eliminarles. También conoce la fuerza que tiene ahora Vegeta... Nuestros amigos tienen que esconderse ahora de su antiguo enemigo y también del tirano.
programme.sub-title: ¡La ambición de Vegeta! Yo soy el guerrero más poderoso del Universo

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: Gracias al maestro de la Torre Sagrada, Goku se libra del hospital con una sola alubia mágica. El padre de Bulma ha estado trabajando en una nueva nave que llevará a Goku a Namek
programme.sub-title: ¡Gokū al máximo de poder! 6 días hasta el otro extremo de la Galaxia.

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: Aunque los namekianos son poderosos, se enfrentan nada menos que a la elite de Freezer.Los habitantes de Namek no tienen suficiente fuerza para derrotarles, pero también cuentan con buenos luchadores.
programme.sub-title: ¡Ataque por sorpresa! El objetivo del anciano son los scouters

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: Ante los despiadados métodos de este líder sin alma, Gohan no aguanta más y decide luchar
programme.sub-title: ¡Gohan en peligro! La persecución del mortífero Dodoria

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: Goku entrena sin descanso en la nave que le llevará hacia Namek. Como es un astronauta inexperto, la reparación de la nave se convierte en una auténtica aventura, pero eso le permite aumentar su fuerza.
programme.sub-title: ¡Dodoria explota! La temible onda de choque de Vegeta

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: Vegeta desata el terror en el poblado y se enfrenta a todos los guerreros que le presentan batalla.
programme.sub-title: ¡Huida del planeta en llamas! Un desesperado Kamehameha.

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: Mientras Goku se entrena en la nave, Kaito se comunica con él y le da una sorpresa increíble. ¡Todos sus amigos están con el maestro! Los espíritus de Yamcha, Chaos, Ten Shin Han y Piccolo están con él.
programme.sub-title: ¡Coraje x 100! Los guerreros se reúnen con Kaio!

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: Vegeta se encuentra con Zarbon y lecuenta sus planes: ser inmortal y destruir al tirano. Zarbon es el tercer guerrero de la guardia personal de Freezer y no se libra del enfrentamiento contra el guerrero del espacio, que le demuestra sus progresos.

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: Zarbon pilla a Vegeta por sorpresa porque no espera que el soldado de elite sea capaz de nada mejor. ¡El soldado se transforma en un horrible monstruo ante los asombrados ojos del saiyano
programme.sub-title: ¡Escalofrío! La diabólica transformación del apuesto guerrero Zaabon

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: Krilín y Denda llegan hasta la residencia del Jefe Supremo sanos y salvos. El padre de todos los habitantes del planeta es un anciano con un gran poder que, además de darle una bola de dragón a Krilín, le despierta el poder que dormía en su interior.
programme.sub-title: ¡Defended el planeta de la esperanza¡. El sorprendente aumento de poder de Klilin

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: Freezer ordena a Zarbon que recoja el cuerpo de Vegeta que ha quedado en un estado crítico después de su lucha contra la versión transformada del soldado del tirano. Sorprendentemente, las órdenes de Freezer son curarle, a riesgo de la vida de Zarbon
programme.sub-title: Resurrección a las puertas de la muerte. El hombre milagroso, Vegeta

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: Krilín llega junto a Bulma con la bola de dragón que le ha regalado el Jefe Supremo de los nameks. Pero no se ha dado cuenta que no ha logrado despistar a Vegeta. El saiyano ha descubierto su escondite y también la bola de dragón que tiene.
programme.sub-title: ¡Una fuerza de combate inmensa! Los planes de Freeza se desmoronan

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: El aguerrido Vegeta se enfrenta otra vez a Zarbon. Pero en esta ocasión, Vegeta ha aprendido a mantener la guardia frente a Zarbon y le obliga a transformarse ante los atónitos ojos de Bulma y Krilín
programme.sub-title: ¡Vuelvo a ser el de siempre! Goku se enfrenta a una gravedad de 100

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: Freezer intuye la derrota del guerrero Zarbon y monta en cólera. En otra parte de Namek, Vegeta se da cuenta de que le han robado una bola de dragón. ¡Y sospecha del pequeño Son Gohan porque se ha encontrado con él hace poco!
programme.sub-title: ¡El arma secreta de Freeza! Las diabólicas Fuerzas Especiales Ginyu

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: Goku se dirige hacia el planeta Namek en la nave que el padre de Bulma ha construido para él. Mientras, Bulma se encarga de la bola de dragón que Son Gohan le ha robado a Vegeta, y las desgracias empiezan a sucederse una detrás de otra.
programme.sub-title: ¡Bulma está en peligro! La bola de cuatro estrellas cae en las manos de Freeza.

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: Bulma sigue en las manos de sus captores y tiene que utilizar todo su ingenio para librarse de ellos.
programme.sub-title: ¡Colisión frontal! El Kame Hame Ha y el Kaioh Ken

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: Aunque está muerta de miedo, Bulma ha conseguido escapar. ¡Y tiene la bola de dragón! Han pasado cuatro días desde que Krilín y Son Gohan abandonaron el refugio; deciden utilizar su poder y avanzar rápido a sabiendas del riesgo que corren.
programme.sub-title: ¡La batalla definitiva se aproxima! ¡Llegan las Fuerzas Especiales Ginyu!

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: Las temidas Fuerzas Especiales de Freezer acaban de llegar. Los pobres Krilín, Son Gohan y Bulma tienen que contar... ¡cinco enemigos más! Y Goku aún no ha llegado.
programme.sub-title: ¡Gokū se aproxima a toda velocidad! Hay que escapar de las redes de Freeza

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: Lo imposible se convierte en realidad cuando Krilín y Son Gohan se ven forzados a colaborar con su mayor enemigo, Vegeta, para tener una oportunidad contra las Fuerzas Especiales
programme.sub-title: ¡¿Truco o súper-magia?! ¡El Sr. Gourd se enfurece!

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: Los cinco guerreros de las Fuerzas Especiales superan a Vegeta, Krilín y Son Gohan de largo, pero eso no impide que Vegeta luche. Los poderes de las Fuerzas Especiales asombran a nuestros protagonistas.
programme.sub-title: El salvaje Recoom. Es malo, brutal y extravagante

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: Los guerreros de las Fuerzas Especiales han perdido a uno de sus miembros. Gracias a un ataque combinado, Son Gohan y Krilín han vencido al que dominaba el tiempo. Vegeta hace gala de su poder y se enfrenta a un luchador que parece indestructible
programme.sub-title: ¡No mueras, Gohan! Gokū llega finalmente al campo de batalla

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: El capitán de las fuerzas especiales le lleva las siete bolas de dragón a Freezer, pero el tirano se enoja porque no sabe como activarlas
programme.sub-title: ¡Una fuerza fuera de lo normal! Gokū, el Super Saiyajin de la leyenda

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: Goku aterriza en Namek, justo donde su hijo, Krilín y Vegeta han caído malheridos. Goku detecta enseguida a Freezer: ha llegado el momento de demostrar la evolución del guerrero después de su largo entrenamiento en el espacio.
programme.sub-title: ¡Una bola relámpago azul y roja! Jeese y Burtta atacan a Gokū

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: Una antigua leyenda cuenta que cada mil años despierta un guerrero supersaiyano con poderes increíbles. Vegeta se niega a creer que pueda ser Goku, pero la fuerza de su antiguo adversario le sorprende cada vez más
programme.sub-title: ¡Al fin una confrontación directa! El capitán Ginyu entra en combate

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: El capitán de las Fuerzas Especiales custodia las bolas de dragón mientras Freezer intenta interceptar a un poderoso guerrero namek. Goku vence fácilmente a sus adversarios y, aunque desea perdonar a los que han perdido, Vegeta no es tan indulgente.
programme.sub-title: ¡Qué fuerza más increíble! Has visto todo el poder de Gokū

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: Goku sigue combatiendo contra el poderoso capitán de las Fuerzas Especiales, que aún no ha demostrado su verdadero poder, pero ya se ha dado cuenta que Goku, al igual que él, tiene la habilidad de esconder la fuerza a los enemigos
programme.sub-title: ¿Cuál será el resultado de la batalla? La diabólica mano de Freeza se cierra sobre el Saichoro

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: El gran jefe despierta en Denda su poder interior y le da una misión muy especial. Cuando él falte, deberá convertirse en el líder de su pueblo.
programme.sub-title: ¡Sorpresa! Goku es Ginew y Ginew es Goku

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: El guerrero más poderoso entre los nameks está dispuesto a enfrentarse él solo a Freezer quien, por primera vez, abandona su cómodo sistema de transporte. No hace más que subestimar a este adversario y se ofrece a luchar con una sola mano.

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: El capitán de las Fuerzas Especiales decide agotar su última baza: un poder que jamás ha mostrado. Goku ve cómo el capitán se hiere a sí mismo para abandonar el cuerpo en que se encuentra e invadir el de Goku como huésped
programme.sub-title: ¡Ese no soy yo!¡Gohan tienes que golpear a tu padre!

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: Goku está en el cuerpo moribundo del capitán de las Fuerzas Especiales pero no se rinde y acumula toda su voluntad para ir en busca de su cuerpo. Al llegar a la nave, Krilín y Son Gohan intentan invocar al dragón sagrado.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Steel
programme.desc: Boxing robot "Battling Maxo" breaks down before the scheduled bout, forcing his manager to take its place.
